business_summary.text: Goodluck India Limited is a manufacturer of precision-engineered steel products for high-growth sectors including automotive, solar, railways, and defence. The company operates through segments including engineering structures, precision pipes, CR coils, and forgings, with a growing focus on defence through its subsidiary Goodluck Defence & Aerospace Ltd.

call_points.text: EBITDA margin expansion driven by operational efficiencies and product mix
Defense capacity expansion to 400,000 shells planned, likely in FY28.
Defense EBITDA margin guided at 30-35%, down from 68-70% in FY26 due to full-year operations.
Global shell demand estimated at 8-9 million vs supply of 2-3 million over next 1-2 years.
Debt repayment of ₹54 crores in FY27 and ₹51 crores in FY28.
Raw material (HRC) shortage persists; management said situation has not normalized.
Inventory days have not normalized due to delayed dispatches from West Asia crisis.

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 2 Per Share

guidance.statement: We still hope that we can be at the lower or 14%, 15% growth we still hope that we will get.
We are expecting almost -- our capacity is 150,000, and we expect almost 75% to 80% execution this year.
the EBITDA margins of 68% or 70%, these are not long sustaining. In the coming years, what the guidance we have given of 30%, 35%, it will prevail.
Defence capacity expansion to 400,000 shells per annum within 12-15 months

operating_notes.text: Secured largest ever export order in the division worth USD 13.6 Mn (approx. 14,500 MT) for a 400 kV D/C transmission line project in Nepal, to be executed in 18 months.
Recommended final dividend of ₹3.00 per share (150%) for FY26.
Goodluck India recorded total sales volume of 4,68,161 MT during FY26, marking a YoY growth of 5.8%.
Secured order for 20,000 empty 155mm shells worth ₹52.20 Cr.
Defense vertical achieved ₹46 crores revenue in FY26 with ₹29 crores EBITDA.
Net debt at ₹1,000 crores (working capital ₹800 crores, term loan ₹200 crores); cash and bank balance ₹50 crores.
Capacity utilization at 94% in FY26; capacity addition of 40,000-45,000 tons in GI conduit pipes and front fork tubes over 9-12 months.
Export revenue contributed ~29% of total revenue in Q1FY27
Defence division secured ₹255 Cr order for 155mm artillery shells

timeline.summary: M C Garg and Sons HUF, Mahesh Chand Garg, Manish Garg, and 42 others declared no encumbrance on shares held in Goodluck India Limited under SEBI regulations as of March 31, 2021, filed April 3, 2026.
Goodluck India secured an export order worth USD 13.6 million from an EPC player in Nepal for transmission line structures.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,088.46 Cr (-1.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹54.55 Cr (+30.1% YoY).
Goodluck India reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,097.2 Cr (-1.4% YoY) and net profit of ₹56.1 Cr (+33.9% YoY), alongside its entry into global defence supply chains.
Goodluck India secured a domestic order worth ₹52.20 Cr for 20,000 empty 155mm shells to be executed within 3 months.
Goodluck India Limited shared the audio recording link for its conference call with investors and analysts on 28th May 2026 discussing Q4 and FY 2026 results.
Goodluck India held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 28, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹1,097.2 Cr and PAT of ₹56.1 Cr.
Q1FY27 results: Revenue ₹1,292 Cr (+31% YoY), EBITDA ₹67.2 Cr (+46% YoY), PAT ₹67.2 Cr (+67% YoY)
Goodluck India Limited scheduled a conference call to discuss Q2 FY 2027 results on 31 October 2026 at 11:30 AM IST.
